_comment: How each demo loop is built: the view it is rendered from and the pose@frame keys it runs through. animate.py reads this when given only a slug and an output path, so a shipped loop can be re-made without guessing. ⚠ ONLY SPECS THAT HAVE BEEN RENDERED AND PASSED THE CHECKS BELONG HERE. A guess would be worse than an empty table: the file's whole purpose is to be trusted, and a wrong spec produces a DIFFERENT loop while looking authoritative. The thirteen loops shipped before this file existed are not in it yet — their specs were never written down and have to be re-derived and verified one at a time. Guessing one for squat_goblet was rejected at frame 4 with the fingers of both hands through each other, which is how the gap was found. See docs/anatomy-renders.md.
